content.instructions: For “Sie” the imperative is the infinitive plus “Sie”, with the verb first: “Gehen Sie!” For “du” you drop “-st”: “Geh!” Verbs with e → i keep the change: “Nimm!” “Lies!” For “ihr” it is the “ihr” form without “ihr”: “Geht!” A separable prefix goes to the end: “Steigen Sie aus!”
